scale.title: Limits and states by RPM
scale.hint: Each tier says up to which value each equipment state applies. Every alignment keeps the scale it was recorded with, even if it changes later.
scale.needsTier: The scale needs at least one RPM tier
scale.onlyLastOpen: Only the last tier may have no ceiling
scale.needsBand: Each tier needs at least one limit
scale.bandsClimb: Within a tier, each limit must be greater than the previous one
scale.stateOnce: A state appears once per tier

explain.title: What is recorded here?
explain.what: A laser alignment of the shaft between two machines of a train (the driver, e.g. the motor, and the driven one, e.g. the pump), measured before and after correcting it.
explain.values: Eight values: angular and offset, in the horizontal and vertical views, before (As Found) and after (As Corrected). Angular in mm/100 mm, offset in mm.
explain.states: From the RPM, the alignment norma gives the tolerance and the machine's state (Operational, Under observation, Alarm…), before and after.
explain.images: The aligner's screens per train: SKF prints one image with before and after; any other aligner, one per phase. Plus the train's photo and up to two of the finding.
explain.example: Example — WATER PUMP TAG:A · Motor → Pump · 1780 rpm · SKF TKSA 41. Before: angular H 0.08, offset H 0.12, angular V 0.05, offset V 0.10 → Alarm. After: 0.02 · 0.03 · 0.01 · 0.02 → Operational.
explain.where: If the job belongs to an alignment order, it is registered from that order's visit and shows here with its code. Otherwise it is a one-off job, created here.
